summary: Import ResQ Reserving Class now checks every dataset the ArcRho Engine generates against ResQ's copy and warns when any cell differs at two decimal places.
details: After the Engine has built a generated triangle or vector, the import reads ResQ's values for the same dataset and compares them cell by cell, treating a blank on one side and a number on the other as a difference.
The completion box turns into a warning that stays on screen, naming each differing dataset, how many cells differ, and the first differing cell with both values.
The Engine result is kept in ArcRho either way; the warning tells you where ResQ would show different numbers.
